title: 第 7 章 这混蛋何时变得这么强了
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
就在这时他的眼前突然弹出了系统的面板。

    【宿主真是丧心病狂竟然打算残害同门师姐，并做出此等人神共愤的恶事。】

    【请宿主完成残害同门的恶行，任务完成后可获得上品法术一本。】

    看完系统的提示之后他在心里忍不住吐槽了一句，这破系统是真抽象啊。

    明明是陆瑶先动的手而且还伤了周玄，现在又要抢他的灵石结果系统说他妄图残害同门？

    接受了任务之后他便收回思绪将注意力收回了现实。

    而此时的陆瑶见他半天不说话以为是怕了，因此脸上露出了更加得意的笑容。

    “怎么不说话了？”刚才不是挺能说的吗现在知道怕了？”

    “我告诉你陈默今天你要是不把灵石还给我，今天这事没完。”

    可陈默没有理会她的废话，而是站在那里冷冷的看着她。

    见他还是不说话陆瑶心里反倒有些急了，于是她转过头看着林凤瑶。

    “凤瑶师姐你看看他这是什么态度，你作为他的师姐难道不该管管他吗？”

    不过林凤瑶却没有立刻回应，但是目光倒是一直停留在陈默身上，而且能感觉到他身上的气息和早上完全不一样了。

    那种感觉让她有些不安所以她暂时没有开口，可是陆瑶见林凤瑶不管这事心里更加着急了。

    于是又转过头看着陈默。

    “你聋了是不是，我跟你说话呢你没听到？我再说一遍把灵石还给我。”

    “我要是不还呢？”他淡淡道。

    “不还？那你就别怪我不客气了。”

    “你现在不客气一个给我看看。”

    显然陆瑶是被他这句话彻底激怒了。

    “陈默你找死！”

    啪的一声突然响起，没想到陈默竟然一巴掌扇在了她脸上。

    这一巴掌他用了不小的力气，而且直接把她扇得往旁边踉跄了两步，只见她捂着脸整个人都愣住了不敢相信陈默竟然敢动手打她。

    旁边的周玄看到这一幕整个人也愣住了，因此在心里也是担心的不行可现在他的身体状况恐怕连站起来都费劲。

    “你……你敢打我？”陆瑶瞪大眼睛看着他。

    “打你怎么了？”

    “你知不知道我哥是谁，你打我你就等死吧你！”

    她被气得浑身发抖而且脸上的红手印越来越明显，从小到大还没有人敢动她一根手指头，没想到今天她竟然被陈默这个废物扇了耳光这口气她怎么咽得下去。

    “我杀了你！”接着陆瑶彻底破防了，只听她大吼一声拿起手中的剑就朝陈默刺了过去。

    如今她的修为是筑基九层这一剑几乎用尽了全力，在她看来陈默上次不过是运气好才侥幸赢了自己，这一剑下去他必死无疑。

    可她错了。

    只见陈默侧身一闪轻松就躲开了她这一剑。
content_en:
At this moment, the system panel suddenly popped up in front of his eyes.

    [The host is so heartbroken that he actually plans to kill his fellow senior sister and commit such evil deeds that are outrageous to both humans and gods. 】

    [Ask the host to complete the evil deed of harming his fellow disciples. After completing the task, you will receive a high-quality spell. 】

    After reading the system prompts, he couldn't help but complain in his heart, this broken system is really abstract.

    It was obviously Lu Yao who made the move first and injured Zhou Xuan, and now she wants to steal his spirit stone, but the system says he tried to harm his fellow disciples?

    After accepting the task, he withdrew his thoughts and returned his attention to reality.

    At this time, Lu Yao saw that he had not spoken for a long time and thought he was afraid, so she showed an even more proud smile on her face.

    "Why don't you speak?" Weren't you quite able to speak just now? Now you know you're afraid? "

    "I'm telling you Chen Mo, if you don't return the spirit stone to me today, this matter will never be over. "

    But Chen Mo ignored her nonsense and stood there looking at her coldly.

    Seeing that he still didn't speak, Lu Yao felt a little anxious, so she turned her head and looked at Lin Fengyao.

    "Sister Fengyao, look at his attitude. As his senior sister, shouldn't you be in charge of him? "

    However, Lin Fengyao did not respond immediately, but her eyes remained on Chen Mo, and she could feel that the aura on his body was completely different from that in the morning.

    That feeling made her a little uneasy, so she didn't speak for the time being, but Lu Yao became even more anxious when she saw that Lin Fengyao didn't care about it.

    So he turned around and looked at Chen Mo.

    "Are you deaf? Didn't you hear me talking to you? I say again give me the spirit stone. "

    "What if I don't pay it back? "He said calmly.

    "Don't pay back? Then don't blame me for being rude. "

    "You are welcome to show me one now. "

    Obviously Lu Yao was completely angered by his words.

    "Chen Mo, you are seeking death! "

    There was a sudden snap, and Chen Mo unexpectedly slapped her in the face.

    He used a lot of force to slap her, and he slapped her so hard that she staggered two steps to the side. She was stunned as she covered her face and couldn't believe that Chen Mo dared to hit her.

    Zhou Xuan next to him was stunned when he saw this scene, so he was also worried in his heart. But now his physical condition may make it difficult to even stand up.

    "You...you dare to hit me? "Lu Yao looked at him with wide eyes.

    "What's wrong with hitting you? "

    "Do you know who my brother is? If you hit me, you will die!" "

    She was so angry that she was shaking all over and the red handprints on her face became more and more obvious. No one dared to touch her since she was a child. She didn't expect that today she would be slapped by Chen Mo, a loser. How could she swallow this breath?

    "I'll kill you! "Then Lu Yao's defense was completely broken. She yelled, picked up the sword in her hand, and stabbed Chen Mo.

    Now that her cultivation level is at the ninth level of foundation building, she almost used all her strength with this sword strike. In her opinion, Chen Mo was just lucky enough to win against her last time. With this strike, he will definitely die.

    But she was wrong.

    Chen Mo turned sideways and easily dodged her sword.
title_en: Chapter 7 When did this bastard become so strong?
